analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – solves a frustrating problem for families managing critical documents. The ‘Built for Humans’ approach is a positive differentiator.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Reasonable – addresses a widespread need for organization and accessibility of important documents. The target audience is large but fragmented.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Moderate – core AI components are complete, but a Q2 2026 launch is a significant timeline. Beta access is a good starting point.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Basic – subscription model, but lacks detail on pricing or long-term strategy.  Reliance on AI answers introduces risk.', 'Differentiation': '• Moderate – ‘Built for Humans’ is a differentiator, but the AI-powered Q&A is a common feature in similar services.  Privacy focus is a plus.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Weak – relies heavily on personal experience and claims of ‘privacy as a core principle.’  No concrete evidence of effectiveness or user feedback.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Moderate – acknowledges delays and scaling issues, but lacks specific mitigation strategies.  Reliance on AI answers is a significant risk.', 'Pros': '• Clear problem statement and solution. • Core technology is developed. • Mobile scanning feature is valuable. • Privacy focus.', 'Cons': '• Long timeline. • Limited differentiation. • Reliance on AI introduces potential inaccuracies and liability. • Lack of evidence or user feedback. • Basic revenue model.'}, 'Project B': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• More complex – the concept of ‘verifiable digital fingerprints’ is abstract. The core value – establishing provenance – is compelling.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Large and growing – addresses concerns around fraud and authenticity in digital transactions. Initial focus on matching gifts is a smart starting point.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Early stage – primarily focused on conceptualization and a lightweight implementation. The open-source widget is a good initial step.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Promising – transaction-based model has potential, but needs further validation through testing.', 'Differentiation': '• Strong – the focus on ‘heirloom-quality’ provenance and a machine-readable ledger is unique.  The focus on semantic clarity is a key advantage.', 'Impact and Evidence Plan': '• Developing – plans for surveys and pilot tests are positive, but require careful execution.  The Fair Trade specification is a valuable starting point.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Moderate – relies on community-run witness networks, which introduces potential vulnerabilities.  The focus on a single standard initially mitigates risk.', 'Pros': '• Strong differentiation. • Addresses a critical market need. • Lightweight implementation. • Focus on verifiable provenance and a machine-readable ledger. • Clear testing plan.', 'Cons': '• Abstract value proposition. • Early stage of development. • Reliance on community-run witness networks introduces risk. • Revenue model requires validation.'}}
